draft.title: Mercury opposite Chiron
draft.humanMoment: A renter reporting a ceiling leak loses the rehearsed explanation and snaps when the repair-line operator questions whether the problem is urgent.
draft.developmentDetail: A page of careful notes sits beside the phone as the caller alternates between strained cheerfulness, long pauses, and precise details about the spreading stain.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Mercury pushes to describe the damage clearly, while Chiron holds the old expectation that hesitation will be treated as ignorance.
draft.aspectMechanic: The opposition places the renter's halting report across from the operator's demand for a clear account, so neither the leak nor the sharp reaction to being doubted can be edited out of the call.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If the operator treats the sharp reply as a refusal to cooperate, the repair request may close without the spreading damage being logged.

judge.weakest: If the operator treats the sharp reply as a refusal to cooperate, the repair request may close without the spreading damage being logged.
judge.why: The consequence is slightly procedural in phrasing but follows directly and plausibly from the concrete scene. All fields are specific, evergreen, mechanically accurate, and functionally distinct.
